subject: MAP escalation — contingency tranches & gating checklist
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Simon Black <simon.black@acrosoft.com>, AcroSoft Procurement <procurement@acrosoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Jul 27, 2027 at 09:12 AM -0700
Subject: MAP update — evaluation gate friction and suggested contingency tranches

Hi Simon / AcroSoft team,

Quick note after today's eval checkpoint: the MAP (attached v2) shows the evaluation gate (security artifact delivery + procurement signature) slipping by ~3 weeks relative to the original close date. Root cause: procurement turnaround + delayed SOC2 evidence extraction from their side, which blocks our final acceptance run.

Proposed immediate options so we don't lose momentum:
- Option A (staggered go-live): Phase A (non-PHI workload, limited feature set) — tentative go-live Aug 31; Phase B (full production, PHI support) — target Sep 21.
- Option B (single rebaseline): move acceptance to Sep 21 and preserve original cutover scope.

Asks:
1) Can procurement confirm target signature window (this week / next week)?
2) Can you confirm whether AcroSoft is open to a phased acceptance (Option A) so we can ship critical features earlier?
3) Please confirm any additional security artifacts you need (we can bundle SOC2 snapshot + tokenization doc).

Attached: MAP-v2 with revised milestones and a short risk/decision table.

If you prefer a quick call, I can set one up today or tomorrow.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales (Strategic Accounts)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: 20270727-MAP-v2.xlsx
From: Simon Black <simon.black@acrosoft.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: AcroSoft Procurement <procurement@acrosoft.com>
Date: Tue, Jul 27, 2027 at 11:03 AM -04:00
Subject: Re: MAP update — evaluation gate friction and suggested contingency tranches

Naomi — thanks for the heads up and for the clear options. Short answers:
- Procurement is still routing the final PO and legal redlines; expect signature no earlier than the week of Aug 9 given internal approvals.
- We are open to a phased approach but need clarity on which APIs/features are in Phase A and any limitations (rate limits, data residency).
- Please send the SOC2 snapshot and tokenization brief — security will run a light review this week.

If we can get Phase A limited to non-PHI traffic + read-only endpoints for the first two weeks, we might accept the Aug 31 window. Otherwise, single rebaseline to Sep 21 looks more realistic.

Let's do a 30-min sync tomorrow at 10am ET to align scope; I can include our security lead if needed.

—Simon
VP Product, AcroSoft
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Jul 27, 2027 at 13:28 PM -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: MAP update — procurement window and phased approach (escalation)

Folks — forwarding AcroSoft's reply. Short summary and suggested risk posture:

Summary:
- Procurement likely signs in the Aug 9 week at the earliest (3+ week slip).
- AcroSoft is open to Phase A (limited non-PHI go-live) but needs explicit scope and performance guardrails.

Impact / risk:
- If we preserve full scope and slip to Sep 21, we hold seat and reduce churn risk but delay ARR recognition.
- If we go phased Aug 31, we expose a narrower feature set (and must document acceptance criteria and rollback paths).

Proposed immediate actions (internal):
1) Prepare a Phase A scope doc (APIs included, rate limits, data residency) and SLA caveats.
2) Produce SOC2 snapshot and tokenization note for tomorrow's call. (I have a condensed SOC2 extract ready — will attach).
3) Pricing/credit ask: recommend we offer a delta credit if final acceptance slips >14 days from the agreed date — propose up to 10% monthly credit for first month of delay to protect the procurement relationship.

Marissa / Ben — do we have latitude on the credit and an approval path? Jonas — can you help define Phase A list and test checklist?

I will set the 10am ET call with AcroSoft and include security.

Thanks,
Naomi
Attachments: SOC2_snapshot.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, Jul 28, 2027 at 08:07 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: MAP update — procurement window and phased approach (escalation)

Naomi / team — I reviewed the ask. Approvals:
- We can approve a one-time concession aligned to your credit proposal: up to 10% credit on the first monthly invoice if acceptance slips more than 14 days from the committed acceptance date. Finance to sign off — Ben please confirm.
- Legal to prepare a short addendum (2 clauses): phased acceptance definition + credit terms. Ben, loop in Legal (use the ACQ-SHORT-ADDENDUM template).
- Jonas, work with Naomi to publish the Phase A feature list and an acceptance checklist (test cases + runbook). Keep scope tight — target <= 6 endpoints and read-only where possible.

Operational asks: CS should prepare a phased cutover runbook (rollforward & rollback) and a monitoring playbook in case Phase A meets errors. Ifthey ask for an accelerated on-prem audit, we prioritize SOC artifacts first.

I agree it's better to preserve relationship via a small credit and phased approach rather than pushing a full rebaseline immediately.

—Marissa
SVP Sales Operations
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Simon Black <simon.black@acrosoft.com>
Cc: AcroSoft Procurement <procurement@acrosoft.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Aug 3, 2027 at 16:43 PM -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP escalation — contingency tranches & gating checklist

Simon — great sync earlier. Per the call, next steps and confirmations below:

Confirmed path: staggered (Phase A + Phase B)
- Phase A target: Aug 31 — non-PHI traffic, 5 read-only endpoints (Auth, Metadata, Embeddings, Search-read, Audit-read).
- Phase B target: Sep 21 — full production and PHI support pending procurement signature and final legal addendum.

Deliverables we attached: SOC2_snapshot.pdf (condensed) and the revised MAP (MAP-v2). Jonas and I will share Phase A acceptance checklist by tomorrow EOD.

Commercial concession: Redwood will extend up to 10% credit on the first monthly invoice if final acceptance slips >14 days from the committed Phase B acceptance date. Legal will prepare the addendum and Marissa/Ben will expedite review.

Meeting notes and timeline links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACR-2027-1087

Please confirm the Phase A scope acceptance and if procurement can commit to an August 9 window for signature routing — that date materially affects our ability to support Phase A readiness.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2_snapshot.pdf, 20270727-MAP-v2.xlsx
